plan.title: A chatty day gets filed into the right pages overnight

context.text: Hey Mike! Ten pages of Project Hail Mary in bed at 9 tonight. You in?

transcript.text: my sister Ana started reading with me this week lol, she's way faster than me

Ha, nice, having Ana reading alongside you is a real boost, Mike. Her pace doesn't matter, your ten pages a night is the whole game, and you've got two days stacked already. Is she reading the same book or her own?
and my dog Max sleeps on my feet while I read, honestly helps me wind down
Love that, Mike. Max on your feet is basically a built-in wind-down routine 🐶 Tonight's ten pages at 9 are going to feel good. What's been your favorite part of Project Hail Mary so far?
saw the cutest dog on my walk today btw

Ha, dogs are clearly your thing, Mike. Save some of that good energy for tonight though: ten pages in bed at 9, and a photo of the page you stop on. And you never told me, what's been your favorite part of Project Hail Mary so far?
Ha, I can tell, Mike. Max is lucky to have you. Now let's get those ten pages in tonight at 9, and I'll be waiting on that photo of your page. What's got you hooked so far in Project Hail Mary?
Hey Mike! Ten minutes to 9, so grab your book and get settled in bed, Max on your feet and all. Ten pages, then a photo of the page you stop on. Ready to go?
Hey Mike! It's 9:25, so how did the ten pages go? Send me a photo of the page you stop on when you're done, and tell Max he did a good job keeping your feet warm.
ok done, 10 pages. Ana's already 3 chapters ahead smh
Nice work getting the ten pages in, Mike. Ana's pace is hers, you're showing up every night, and that's what counts. Send me a photo of the page you stop on and I'll get it checked off. 📚
